page.layout: Two columns: the main text block on the left, and a narrow margin column on the right holding three marginal notes. Running head at the top, catchword and signature at the foot.

main_text.p: Secundò ad affectiones pertinent alia φαινόμενα, quæ vel omnibus absolutè, vel solo excepto Sole, Planetis coveniút.
Omnibus absolutè Planetis conve-niunt, Altitudo, humilitas, & directio. Excepto Sole Planetis conveniunt, regressio, statio, & latitudo.
Distributio Planetarum est in duo genera: Prioris generis sunt Luminaria: quæ sunt Planetæ, distinguentes diem & noctem, lucem & tenebras, in cœlo omnium maximi apparentes.Planetarum di-stributio
Luminaribus quandoq; accidit Ecli-psis, quæ est radiorum præcipuè solarium aversio seu exclusio, quæ fit interposito corpore opaco.
Eclipsis omnis fit in Zodiaco, & quidem in nodis, vel propè nodos, intra tamen terminos Eclipticos.
Nodi dicuntur hic puncta, in quibus se interse-cant via Solis & Lunæ, eorumque figura dicitur Draco.Nodi
Nodus Draconis est Superior, vel Inferior.
Superior seu caput Draconis, est punctū illud, ubi Luna ab Ecliptica digrediens ad verticè nostrū versꝰ Septètrioné ascédit.Caput Draconis

page.notes: Right margin: three notes, "Planetarum distributio", "Nodi" and "Caput Draconis", placed beside the paragraphs where they stand. The word "coveniút" is printed with an acute accent on the u, kept as printed. The "Ecli-psis" hyphen is printed at the line end.
